description: Betaflight CLI and Meshtastic terminal for M5Stack Cardputer Zero

store.summary: Betaflight CLI and backups, plus Meshtastic mesh chat, on Cardputer Zero.
store.description: A native serial field terminal for the M5Stack Cardputer Zero. Connect a Betaflight flight controller over USB or UART to summarize current arming blockers, gyro, receiver, battery, I2C, and scheduler evidence; inspect the raw CLI output; run commands; and create or restore Configurator-shaped backups. Risky motor and erase commands require confirmation. Connect a Meshtastic radio instead and the same screen lists every node the radio has heard, opens a conversation with any of them or the broadcast channel, shows delivery state from the mesh's own routing replies, and keeps each transcript on the device. With a LoRa Cap fitted, its GNSS receiver adds range and bearing to nodes that reported a position, and a position you can choose to transmit. GNDHOG ZERO runs locally without a network connection or background service.
